notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection requires a separate Get details action; saving alone does not fetch metadata.
REF-BM-05: No delete endpoint or user action is implemented.
REF-BM-10: Existing-tag autocomplete is available only in the creation form, not while editing tags.
REF-BM-14: Search treats #tag as ordinary text and stored tags contain no # prefix.
REF-BM-15: Search has no Boolean operator or parenthesis parser.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed; quote characters are searched literally.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and viewed, but Markdown is escaped and displayed as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot creation or storage exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive and restore are implemented, but permanent deletion is absent, so the full distinction is incomplete.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and saved filter combinations are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings facility is implemented.
